```python
import os, glob

print("CWD:", os.getcwd())
hits = []
for pat in ['survey_points*.csv', '*.csv', '**/*.csv']:
    hits += glob.glob(pat, recursive=True)
hits = sorted(set(hits))
print("CSV files found:", hits if hits else "NONE")

df = None
if os.path.exists('survey_points.csv'):
    import pandas as pd
    df = pd.read_csv('survey_points.csv')
    print(df.dtypes)
    print(df.head())
else:
    print("survey_points.csv still not present -> cannot determine source CRS.")
```
